declarations.description: Read-aloud trigger for an item or passage header inside `<pie-item-scope>` or `<pie-passage-shell>`: play/pause opens a panel of speed, rewind, fast-forward and stop controls. It reads the shell's content region through the TTS service in the toolkit runtime context, passing `catalog-id` so the service can speak authored SSML from the accessibility catalogs. Its controls stay disabled until the runtime context supplies a TTS service.
